title: When a Commercial Roof Gets a Coating
description: A coating can add years to a sound Houston commercial roof. It cannot fix wet insulation or a membrane that has already failed.
html:
A coating is a layer you put on a roof that still has a future. It is not a way to bury a wet one. On a low-slope Houston building, the question is whether the sheet and the insulation are dry, not whether the field looks tired from the parking lot. A bright white roof can be a coating or a new membrane. The photo does not tell you which. A core cut does.

A coating is the job when

The membrane is attached, the seams can be detailed, and a core comes up dry. Ponding that leaves standing water for days is a drainage problem first. Coating over that pond just makes a white puddle. That is ponding water on a low-slope roof. Open TPO welds are a seam repair, or a new sheet, before anyone talks about a coating. See TPO seams in Texas heat.

A coating is the wrong job when

The insulation is wet, the deck is soft, or the membrane has shrunk off the edges. Those roofs need a commercial roof replacement, not a surface. When the deck is sound and the sheet can take it, the work lives on coatings and restoration.
